ai.summary: With this update, Insider Risk Management will help admins identify risky AI usage. We are adding new detections of intentional and unintentional insider risk activity on generative AI apps that can pose a risk to an organization.

rm-480730.description:
With this update, Insider Risk Management will help admins identify risky AI usage. We are adding new detections of intentional and unintentional insider risk activity on generative AI apps that can pose a risk to an organization. Activities will include risky prompts containing sensitive info or risky intent and sensitive responses containing sensitive info or is generated from sensitive files or sites. Coverage will span across Microsoft Copilots and 3P generative AI apps. These detections will also contribute to Adaptive Protection insider risk levels.

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy. #copilotcontrolsystem
rm-480730.title: Insider Risk Management - Risky AI usage

Trigger: When a form is submitted
This operation triggers a flow when a list form, document generation form, or file upload form is submitted. Customers can use this trigger to initiate automated workflows such as approvals, notifications, or routing based on form submission events.

Action: Get form metadata

This release enables organizations to bring people data from external systems into Microsoft 365 along with associated access control lists (ACLs), ensuring Copilot respects existing permissions defined in source systems. The imported data can be scoped to specific individuals and groups, allowing Copilot to reason over people data while honoring access restrictions.
rm-561326.title: Copilot People Connectors introduces people data ingestions with differentiated access control

ai.action_note: Inform government cloud users about new Copilot capabilities available for creating and analyzing forms.
ai.summary: Copilot in Microsoft Forms is launching for US Government Cloud environments, offering AI assistance to create, refine, distribute, and analyze forms. Users can access features like Draft with Copilot, on-canvas rewrites, and Copilot Insights.

rm-561485.description: Copilot in Forms is being enabled for Microsoft Forms in Government Cloud environments, bringing end-to-end AI assistance to forms, from creating a form, to refining and sending to analyzing results. This rollout includes key Copilot features such as: - Draft with Copilot - Distribution and monitoring - Copilot Insights - On-canvas Copilot features such as Rewrite question, Continue writing, Answer explanations, and more.
rm-561485.title: Copilot in Forms - US Government clouds

ai.action_note: Notify users of the updated chat layout and navigation changes in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app.
ai.summary: The Microsoft 365 Copilot web and desktop apps feature a redesigned interface, including a revised chat home screen, updated response layouts, and a refreshed navigation pane. This simplifies navigation and daily interactions.

rm-561488.description: A refreshed design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot web and desktop app simplifies the user experience to drive engagement with Copilot. This includes updates to the chat home screen, chat response layout, and navigation pane.
rm-561488.title: Simplified design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot app

ai.summary: Developers can now add, modify, or remove tools on MCP servers without republishing declarative agents. End users receive tool updates instantly while organizations maintain standard enterprise security and deployment controls.

rm-561855.description: We're introducing dynamic tool discovery for declarative agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Developers can now add, update, or retire tools on their MCP servers without republishing the agent - so end users get the latest agent capabilities immediately, with no deployment cycle in between. Support for federated Copilot connectors will be a fast follow to declarative agents at a later stage. Dynamic tool discovery is backed by Microsoft's enterprise RAI and security protections, and customers retain full control over agent deployment and availability to users and groups.
rm-561855.title: Dynamic Tool Discovery for Declarative Agents and Federated Copilot Connectors

ai.summary: Makers can now use a SharePoint list of up to 20,000 items as a knowledge source in Agent Builder. This allows users to query structured list data directly when interacting with Copilot agents.

rm-561920.description: Agent Builder now supports using a SharePoint list as a knowledge source for agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Makers can ground an agent in structured list data so users can ask questions and get responses based on information stored in a selected SharePoint list. For this release, each agent can reference one SharePoint list with up to 20,000 items, alongside other knowledge source types. Support for list attachments and lookup columns is not yet available.
rm-561920.title: SharePoint list support in Agent Builder

ai.summary: Key Copilot metrics in Viva Advanced Analysis custom queries and reports now reflect data that is only two to three days old. This gives analysts fresher data to evaluate workplace Copilot usage.

rm-562017.description: Key Microsoft 365 Copilot metrics in custom person queries and reports will have values up to 2-3 days old from the current date. This will provide fresher copilot usage analysis to analysts in Viva Advanced analysis.
rm-562017.title: Fresh Copilot Metrics in Custom Person Queries & Reports- Viva Advanced Analysis

ai.summary: Employees can now listen to AI-generated audio summaries of SharePoint News posts directly within the SharePoint app for Teams. This provides a quick listening option for staying informed on organizational news.

rm-562018.description: Users will be able access an AI generated audio summary of SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams (Viva Connections).
rm-562018.title: AI overview for SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams

ai.summary: Microsoft has cancelled plans to add AI-powered computer use and UI automation tools to Copilot Studio. Teams planning to build automations that navigate apps and websites will not receive this feature.

rm-562220.description: Add resilient, AI-powered UI automation directly into your workflows with computer use tools. Makers can build reusable, goal-oriented automations that adapt dynamically to website or app changes, while admins maintain governance through access controls, hosted browser management, and environment-level permissions. Update: This roadmap item is no longer accurate and will be removed from the roadmap. We apologize for any inconvenience.
rm-562220.title: Supercharge your workflows with computer use

ai.summary: Copilot Studio now supports Model Context Protocol compliant tools inside agent workflows. Makers can integrate custom actions, dynamic knowledge, and external systems into their agents without having to build redundant integrations.

rm-562221.description: Integrate proprietary systems, dynamic knowledge sources, and custom actions into your agentic workflows with MCP support, accelerating extensibility while preserving workflow reliability. This integration improves reuse across agents and workflows, reduces duplication of integrations, and embraces an emerging open and extensible agent ecosystem.
rm-562221.title: Use MCP-compliant tools in agent workflows

ai.summary: Copilot Studio workflows can now include an agent node to reason over data and invoke tools in a single step. This reduces manual handoffs and complex coding when automating nuanced business decisions.

rm-562222.description: Add an agent node to your workflow to reason over data, call tools, and return a response, all within a single step. The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional development effort, helping teams automate more of their end-to-end processes and reduce operational overhead.
rm-562222.title: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node

ai.summary: Microsoft has cancelled plans to introduce suggested edits from Copilot into Copilot Pages. Users will not receive automated recommendations to improve the clarity and quality of their page content.

rm-562351.description: Request feedback from Copilot on your Page by selecting "Suggested edits" in the Copilot Shortcuts menu. Copilot will analyze the content on your page and provide actionable suggestions about what you can change to improve clarity and quality of your written content. You can then apply suggestions directly to the page. Updated October 23, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.
rm-562351.title: Get actionable suggestions from Copilot in your Copilot Page

ai.summary: Users can now share full Copilot chat sessions or single responses via links that open in read-only mode for colleagues to continue in their own chats. This makes sharing AI insights and collaborating faster than copying and pasting.

rm-562353.description: Session and Response Sharing let Microsoft 365 Copilot users share Copilot chat content through a link. Session Sharing shares a full chat session, while Response Sharing shares a single Copilot response. The shared content opens as a read-only view, and recipients can continue from it in their own Copilot chat. This gives Copilot users an easier and more controlled way to share useful Copilot outputs with coworkers instead of copying and pasting. It helps teams reuse work, share context, and collaborate more efficiently while keeping sharing within organizational controls.
rm-562353.title: Session and Response Sharing in M365 Copilot

ai.action_note: Inform users about the more concise search layout and sidebar chat option.
ai.summary: Copilot Answers in Copilot Search now delivers shorter responses and highlights continuing the conversation in the right-hand sidebar. This helps users quickly scan results and transition seamlessly into a deeper chat.

rm-562354.description: Copilot Answers in Copilot Search (in the M365 Copilot App on web and desktop) will provide more concise responses and more prominently highlight the ability to continue in the conversation in Copilot chat on the right-hand sidebar.
rm-562354.title: Updated Copilot Answers

ai.summary: Analysts can now access granular agent usage metrics combined with organizational attributes in the Insights analyst workbench. This allows organizations to build custom reports and track agent adoption trends beyond predefined dashboards.

rm-562412.description: Unlock deeper insights into Copilot agent adoption with flexible, self-serve analytics. Insights global and partition analysts can access and combine granular agent usage metrics with agent and organizational attributes to uncover agent adoption trends, export and customize reporting, and drive more informed decisions, without relying on predefined dashboards.
rm-562412.title: Agent metrics for custom reporting in Insights analyst workbench

ai.summary: Copilot memory in Researcher retains context from prior interactions to personalize outputs and reduce repetitive prompting during research.

rm-562996.description: Copilot memory within Researcher brings forward relevant context from your past interactions—helping ground insights, personalize outputs, and reduce repetitive setup as you explore complex topics.
rm-562996.title: Copilot memory in Researcher

ai.summary: Declarative agents with actions are now available in GCC High and DoD environments. Users can trigger multi-step workflows, call APIs, and execute tasks across enterprise systems directly from Copilot chat.

rm-564606.description: Declarative Agents with Actions enable Microsoft 365 Copilot to take real-world actions by invoking APIs, plugins, and enterprise workflows directly within the chat experience. Using custom actions, declarative agents can call external systems, execute operations, and retrieve or update data, moving beyond Q&A to full task completion. These actions are powered through API plugins, MCP tools, and enterprise connectors, allowing seamless integration with line-of-business applications and services. The Copilot platform dynamically reasons over available actions and selects the appropriate tool to fulfill user intent, enabling multi-step workflows such as creating records, submitting requests, or triggering business processes within a single conversational flow
rm-564606.title: Declarative agents with Actions available in GCC High and DoD

ai.summary: Support for Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based agents is coming to Microsoft 365 Copilot in U.S. Government Clouds. Developers can build agents using MCP servers while users interact with them in familiar Copilot experiences.

rm-564607.description: We’re introducing support for Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot . This update enables developers to build Copilot agents using MCP servers and allows users to interact with these agents using familiar experiences. This change supports extensibility and improves agent capabilities for organizations.
rm-564607.title: MCP-Based Agent Enablement for U.S. Government Clouds

ai.summary: Model Context Protocol agents in Copilot Chat for government clouds can now surface interactive UI widgets directly in conversations. This allows users to view and interact with structured agent content without leaving their chat.

rm-564608.description: Feature description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat will now be able to surface rich, interactive UI widgets directly within chat. This enhancement enables developers to deliver more engaging and structured agent interactions. Users will experience these widgets when interacting with agents that implement them, and admins will continue to manage these agents through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.
rm-564608.title: Support for MCP Agents with Interactive UI Widgets in Government Clouds

ai.summary: Users will be able to choose from multiple voice styles during Microsoft 365 Copilot voice chats. This enables individuals to customize their Copilot audio experience to their personal preference.

rm-564804.description: Users can select from multiple voice style options for their voice experience in M365 Copilot.
rm-564804.title: Multiple Voice Styles in M365 Copilot voice chats

ai.action_note: Notify users they may see automatic filename suggestions in OneDrive rename dialogs and upload notifications.
ai.summary: OneDrive will suggest three content-based file names when renaming or uploading supported Office docs, PDFs, Markdown files, and images. This helps staff organize files faster with one-click renaming.

rm-564909.description:
Copilot Suggested Rename is an AI-powered OneDrive feature that automatically recommends clear, descriptive file names based on a file’s content—helping users organize and find their files more easily with minimal effort. What the feature does:
- Analyzes the content of a file to generate context-aware filename suggestions
- Presents 3 recommended names directly within the rename dialog
- Allows users to pick a suggestion with a single click
Where it shows up:
- Within the rename dialog for supported files
- Within the post-upload toast notification when a single supported file is uploaded
Supported file types:
- Microsoft Office documents
Word (DOCX)
PowerPoint (PPTX)
Excel (XLSX)
- Other document formats
PDF
Markdown (MD)
- Images
rm-564909.title: Copilot suggested rename

ai.summary: Users can now add Outlook emails as reference knowledge sources directly in Copilot Notebooks. This grounds responses in email discussions and decisions to improve outputs like briefs and presentations.

rm-564910.description:
Outlook Emails as References in Copilot Notebooks bring email content into the notebook experience, enabling users to ground Copilot in the conversations, decisions, and context that drive their work.
By adding emails as knowledge sources, users can connect context from their emails directly to their projects, enriching notebooks beyond files alone and improving downstream outputs like presentations and briefs. Available in Copilot Notebooks across Microsoft 365.
rm-564910.title: Outlook Emails in Copilot Notebooks

ai.summary: SharePoint and OneDrive will provide a visual heatmap showing agent activity patterns and hotspots across sites. This helps administrators quickly spot unusual or risky access behaviors.

rm-565027.description: Provides a visual heatmap of agent activity to help admins quickly detect patterns, hotspots, and unusual access behavior.
rm-565027.title: Agent Access Insights heatmap for SharePoint and OneDrive sites

ai.action_note: Notify users about AI call answering and Bookings integration capabilities.
ai.summary: AI-powered call delegation answers incoming Teams calls, gathers context, and schedules follow-ups using Microsoft Bookings. This helps employees filter interruptions and decide when to engage or reconnect with callers.

rm-565216.description: Incoming Teams calls don't wait for a break in your day. Intelligent call delegation provides AI-powered calling assistance so you can focus on the conversations that matter most. It answers calls and gathers context, helping you decide whether to pick up and engage the caller. It can also schedule follow-up appointments through an integration with Microsoft Bookings so you can reconnect with callers at a more convenient time.
rm-565216.title: Intelligent call delegation

ai.action_note: Review your organization's skills data governance needs and use the new setting if you must offboard People Skills data.
ai.summary: Administrators can now permanently delete all People Skills data across their tenant, including skills libraries and user profile data. This allows organizations to fully offboard from People Skills to meet compliance and data governance requirements.

rm-565905.description:
A new admin control in the People Skills settings lets administrators permanently remove their organization's People Skills data from the tenant. With this new control, organizations can delete their entire skills library along with all users confirmed, inferred, and imported skills data—giving them full control to offboard from People Skills in support of data governance and compliance needs.
Once deletion is initiated, skills will no longer appear on user profile cards or be used across Microsoft 365 skills-based experiences such as Copilot and Viva. The control is admin-only with no automatic changes.
rm-565905.title: People Skills- removal and deletion admin control

ai.action_note: Set up usage-based billing in Cost Management within the Microsoft 365 admin center.
ai.summary: Viva Insights introduces dashboards tracking group-level Copilot credit usage for Cowork and Work IQ API. To enable these services for users, administrators must configure usage-based billing in Microsoft 365 Cost Management.

rm-566302.description: Insights into AI spend (Copilot credit usage) at a group or team level will be available in Viva Insights as a dashboard and in Advanced insights. The services in scope of this release are Cowork and Work IQ API. The dashboard experience is available to managers with at least 5 direct reports (scoped access), the Insights analysts, and Global administrators and is enabled by default to ensure immediate access to usage-based cost insights. For users to be able to use Cowork or WorkIQ API, your tenant must have usage-based billing setup via Cost Management in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Leader access to tenant-wide data is out of scope for this release. The same insights will be available for Insights Analysts and Global Administrators in Advanced Insights.
rm-566302.title: Copilot Analytics - Insights in Cowork and WorkIQ spend and usage

ai.summary: Users can save AI-generated filters created in Planner Agent chat for future use across their plans. This helps teams quickly reapply useful task views without having to recreate them.

rm-566314.description: Save AI-filters generated by the Planner Agent for future use on your plans.
rm-566314.title: Save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat

ai.action_note: Train users on capturing meeting audio, images, and notes directly into Copilot Notebooks.
ai.summary: Multimodal capture on Windows enables users to gather audio, images, and notes into Copilot Notebooks. Copilot then automatically converts this content into structured notes containing key decisions and action items.

rm-566322.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. Capture audio, images, and notes in one experience, then let Copilot turn them into structured notes with key insights, decisions, and action items, in a Copilot Notebook of your choice
rm-566322.title: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)

ai.summary: Viva Insights now provides GitHub Copilot spend and usage dashboards for qualifying managers, global analysts, and administrators. This default-enabled feature allows leaders and admins to track AI adoption and make data-driven budgeting decisions.

rm-566470.description: AI spend and usage insights for GitHub Copilot will be available on Viva Insights for managers with at least 5 direct reports (scoped access), Global analysts and Microsoft Global administrators. They can track spend and make data-driven decisions for AI spend and usage in GitHub Copilot. The dashboard is enabled by default to ensure immediate access.
rm-566470.title: Insights for GitHub Copilot spend and usage

ai.action_note: Inform government cloud users about new Copilot presentation generation and editing capabilities.
ai.summary: Government cloud users can now use Copilot in PowerPoint to generate, edit, and format slides using natural language and brand kits. This helps employees create branded presentations much faster directly within their decks.

rm-566701.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot can also connect to your brand kit to apply branded templates, insert brand-approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) users.
rm-566701.title: Edit your document with Copilot in PowerPoint in Government Clouds

ai.action_note: Notify eligible government cloud users of upcoming Copilot slide design and editing tools.
ai.summary: Government cloud users will be able to create, refine, and design PowerPoint presentations with Copilot using natural language and brand-approved assets. This allows personnel to streamline deck creation while staying aligned with organizational brand standards.

rm-566702.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot can also connect to your brand kit to apply branded templates, insert brand-approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) users.
rm-566702.title: Edit your document with Copilot in PowerPoint in Government Clouds

ai.action_note: Notify users about the redesigned Copilot new tab layout and search features.
ai.summary: The Copilot new tab page is getting an upgrade with unified web search, chat, suggested actions, and curated work content. This helps staff find workplace resources and perform tasks more efficiently from one central place.

rm-566703.description: Search, chat, and explore the web from one search box with Copilot-suggested actions and curated work content to help your users get things done faster on the Copilot new tab page. Users will see upgraded Copilot new tab page functionality and features.
rm-566703.title: Upgraded Copilot new tab page

ai.summary: Copilot Notebooks in the Android app now lets users group chats, outputs, and references into a persistent workspace. This keeps context across sessions so mobile users do not have to restart their work each time.

rm-566704.description: Copilot Notebooks in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (Android) now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time.
rm-566704.title: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App (Android)

ai.summary: Makers can now connect SharePoint lists directly into Copilot Studio agents as knowledge sources. This allows copilots to answer questions using live structured data like inventory or tasks without manual data exports or custom integrations.

rm-566859.description: Unlock the full value of your structured data by bringing SharePoint lists directly into your Microsoft Copilot Studio agents. With native support, customers can ground AI responses in up-to-date, business-critical data—such as tasks, inventory, customers, or operations—without manual data movement or complex integrations. This enables more accurate, context-aware copilots that reflect how your business runs, helping teams make faster decisions, reduce errors, and automate workflows with confidence.
rm-566859.title: Use SharePoint lists as a knowledge source

ai.action_note: Review and configure the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext and Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policies to control user access.
ai.summary: Users can send web images straight to Copilot from the Microsoft Edge context menu to analyze visual content and ask questions. This makes image research faster without leaving the browser, while administrators can manage access via policy.

rm-566864.description: Ask Copilot about an image in Edge enables users to instantly analyze images from the web by sending them directly to Copilot from the Edge context menu, making it easy to ask questions, gain insights, and understand visual content without leaving their browsing experience. Admins can control availability to this feature using the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext and Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policies.
rm-566864.title: Ask Copilot about an image

ai.action_note: Inform users about the new artifact creation suggestions available within Copilot Notebooks in OneNote.
ai.summary: Copilot Notebooks in OneNote will suggest and generate artifacts like Word documents, Excel workbooks, and PowerPoint presentations based on notebook notes and Microsoft 365 data. This speeds up drafting deliverables from existing notes.

rm-566870.description: Copilot Notebooks in OneNote now suggests artifacts to create, such as Word documents, Excel workbooks, and PowerPoint presentations, based on Microsoft 365 knowledge and the content in your notebook. Select the suggestion and Copilot will generate the artifact.
rm-566870.title: Suggested Artifact Creation in Copilot Notebooks

ai.action_note: Advise makers and developers to use approved identities instead of personal credentials when building sharable agents.
ai.summary: Copilot Studio will detect credential oversharing and block sharing or publishing of agents and flows that rely on unsafe identities like maker credentials. This protects organizations against unintended access, identity leakage, and privilege escalation.

rm-566873.description: This feature helps organizations reduce security risk by preventing agents and flows from being shared when they rely on unsafe identities, such as maker credentials. By detecting identity oversharing early and enforcing safe‑sharing policies at publish and share time, customers can avoid identity leakage, privilege escalation, and unintended access - while still allowing makers to build and iterate safely within approved guardrails.
rm-566873.title: Enforce safe sharing by detecting credential oversharing

ai.action_note: Review and configure authentication policies to block maker-provided credentials in Copilot Studio.
ai.summary: Administrators can block AI agents from using maker-provided credentials for authentication in Copilot Studio. This ensures agents do not access sensitive systems using maker permissions, strengthening identity governance and regulatory compliance.

rm-566997.description:
By blocking the use of maker's credentials by AI agents, admins can increase the security and compliance of agents in their organizations:
- Prevent unauthorized access to sensitive systems or data that the maker's credentials might have access to.
- Help organizations comply with data protection regulations (such as GDPR or HIPAA) by ensuring only authorized identities are used for data access.
- Enable IT and security teams to enforce organizational policies around identity and access management.
- Increase trust among stakeholders and IT departments, making it easier to adopt AI agents at scale.
rm-566997.title: Block the use of maker-provided credentials for authentication

ai.summary: Makers can now embed reasoning directly into workflows by invoking agents as workflow steps using the agent node. This automates nuanced decisions without custom development, reducing manual handoffs and operational overhead.

rm-566998.description: The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional development effort, helping teams automate more of their end-to-end processes and reduce operational overhead.
rm-566998.title: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node

ai.action_note: Enable express mode on agent-triggered flows to minimize timeouts and flow failures.
ai.summary: Express mode speeds up run times for flows triggered by agents or apps, reducing timeouts and execution failures. This provides faster responses and ensures dependable backend automations during agent interactions.

rm-566999.description: Express mode ensures agents and apps receive timely and reliable responses by dramatically accelerating flow run times. This reduces flow failures, improves user experience, and eliminates costly interruptions caused by timeout issues. Organizations benefit from more dependable automations, higher adoption, and smoother operational workflows.
rm-566999.title: Enable express mode for flows invoked by an agent or app

ai.summary: Copilot agents can now engage customers across web chat, voice, SMS, and email within a single conversation flow. This helps teams maintain continuous customer communication across preferred channels and speeds up lead qualification.

rm-567001.description: A multi‑channel outreach capability, spanning web chat, voice, SMS, and email, is critical for meeting customers in the channel they naturally prefer and increasing the likelihood of timely engagement. By activating the agent across multiple surfaces, we ensure continuity of conversations, reduce drop‑off when a single channel fails, and support the FY27 goal of always‑on, end‑to‑end engagement from initial intent to close. This creates higher response rates, faster qualification, and a more seamless handoff to sales motions.
rm-567001.title: Engage customers across multiple channels (web, voice, SMS & email)

ai.summary: AI will automatically link scheduled customer meetings to the relevant CRM records. This eliminates manual data entry and ensures sales professionals have quick access to deal insights before every call.

rm-567004.description: This feature saves you time by automatically connecting your meetings to the correct CRM records. You have the right deal insights at your fingertips when preparing for customer conversations, so you can focus less on updating records and more on selling with confidence and context.
rm-567004.title: Link meetings to CRM records automatically with AI

ai.summary: New Cowork adoption and impact analytics are now available in the AI Cost and Copilot dashboards, featuring export options and custom analyst queries. This gives leaders and analysts clearer visibility into Copilot usage and related costs.

rm-567005.description: Deeper insights into Cowork adoption and impact accessible from the new AI Cost dashboard and Copilot dashboard. Includes export capability. All metrics can be queried by analysts with the new AI cost query in advanced insights.
rm-567005.title: Insights: Copilot Analytics - Cowork adoption and impact

ai.action_note: Inform classic Outlook users about the new Copilot entry point location and interface.
ai.summary: Classic Outlook is adding the unified Copilot entry point already used across Word, Excel, and other Outlook endpoints. This gives desktop Outlook users a consistent, contextual interface to access AI assistance.

rm-567007.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classic Outlook.
rm-567007.title: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook

ai.summary: Copilot is introducing dynamic, model-driven Rich Answer Cards across key categories including weather, sports, finance, images, video, places, and news across all surfaces.

rm-567008.description: Surface new model-driven, dynamically placed Answer Cards across top 7 segments: weather, sports, finance, images, video, places and news for Entra & MSA users across all surfaces.
rm-567008.title: New Rich Answer Cards

ai.action_note: Inform SharePoint users and makers about creating and managing workflows using natural language prompts.
ai.summary: Users can build SharePoint workflows by describing what they need in plain English, allowing Copilot to configure the triggers, conditions, and actions. This simplifies automating routine list and file tasks directly from the command bar.

rm-567009.description: Describe a workflow intent such as "when files are set to status = Complete, post a message in my Teams chat" and Copilot in SharePoint will assemble the necessary triggers, conditions, and actions to setup your workflow. You can come back to Copilot in SharePoint at any time to make changes or click "Workflows" from the command bar to see your live workflow.
rm-567009.title: Create new workflows with Copilot in SharePoint

ai.summary: A new Microsoft 365 Copilot usage report is launching for GCC High and DoD environments in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Administrators can view enabled and active users, per-app usage breakdowns, and anonymized user activity insights.

rm-567120.description: We will be introducing a new Usage report covering Microsoft 365 Copilot. This report will include total enabled and active users, Copilot usage with a breakout per Microsoft 365 app, and user-level activity insights (anonymized by default). #copilotcontrolsystem
rm-567120.title: Microsoft 365 admin center – New Microsoft 365 Copilot usage report for GCC High & DoD

ai.summary: Administrators in GCC, GCC High, and DoD environments can now access a new Copilot Chat usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center. It provides metrics on active users, per-app usage breakdowns, and anonymized activity insights.

rm-567121.description: We will be introducing a new Usage report covering Copilot Chat. This report will include total active users, Copilot Chat usage with a breakout per Microsoft 365 app, and user-level activity insights (anonymized by default). #copilotcontrolsystem
rm-567121.title: Microsoft 365 admin center - Usage reports - Copilot Chat for GCC, GCC High and DoD

ai.action_note: Review and customize the call recording and transcription notification text to align with organizational policies.
ai.summary: IT administrators can now customize parts of the notification messages shown to users when recording and transcription start in calls. This allows organizations to tailor privacy and compliance messaging for meeting participants.

rm-567302.description: This feature enables IT admins to customize a portion of the user notification messages for recording and transcription during Teams calls.
rm-567302.title: Ability for IT admins to customize the user notification messages for recording and transcription in calls

ai.action_note: Inform users how to manage and execute Planner tasks within Microsoft Cowork.
ai.summary: Microsoft Planner integration is coming to Microsoft Cowork, allowing users to view, create, and manage tasks in one spot. Cowork can also execute related tasks across Microsoft 365 and sync progress back to Planner with user approval.

rm-567315.description: You’ll soon be able to bring your Microsoft Planner into Microsoft Cowork. In Cowork, you can view, create, and update your plans, buckets, goals, and tasks without switching apps. Cowork goes a step further by helping you execute your Planner tasks across Microsoft 365, such as drafting and sending emails, scheduling meetings, posting updates to Teams, and working with files. It can then write progress back to Planner with your approval. You can move from planning your work to getting it done in one place.
rm-567315.title: Capabilities in Microsoft Cowork

ai.summary: Users can now change the language of an automatically generated meeting recap at any point after the meeting ends. This makes it easier for multilingual team members to review discussions in their preferred language.

rm-567458.description: After meeting recap is automatically generated in the translation language chosen during the meeting, users can continue to change the language of the meeting recap after its generated.
rm-567458.title: Multilingual recap available with translation button

ai.action_note: Notify users that they can create and reuse personal skills across SharePoint sites.
ai.summary: Copilot in SharePoint now lets users create personal skills saved to OneDrive that work across all SharePoint sites. This eliminates the need to recreate identical document generation skills or prompts on individual sites.

rm-567668.description: Create your own personal skills in Copilot in SharePoint and use them anywhere you work. Personal skills travel with you across SharePoint sites and OneDrive—so a skill like document generation works everywhere without recreating it per site. You own your skills, saved as a markdown file in your OneDrive.
rm-567668.title: Personal Skills in Copilot in SharePoint

ai.action_note: Review and configure enterprise store plugins permitted for Copilot in SharePoint.
ai.summary: Copilot in SharePoint now supports enterprise store plugins bundling skills and tools governed by IT administrators. This enables organizations to deploy shared capabilities, such as accessibility tools, consistently across SharePoint and other agentic products.

rm-567669.description:
Copilot in SharePoint now supports plugins from your enterprise store. A plugin can bundle skills, MCP servers, and other capabilities that extend what Copilot can do. Any plugin made available to your organization, whether installed tenant-wide by an admin or added by you, works directly in Copilot in SharePoint, all governed by your M365 admin.

ai.summary: Agents published to Agents 365 that support the Agent2Agent protocol can now connect to agents built in Copilot Studio or Agent Builder. This lets developers link enterprise agents directly into Copilot Chat workflows.

rm-567670.description: Agents that are published to Agents 365 are already managed in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.
rm-567670.title: Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents

ai.action_note: Inform team members about the new Planner Agent chat available within Basic Plans.

rm-567671.description: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.
rm-567671.title: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans

ai.summary: Planner Agent can now generate customized status reports directly from task data, covering progress, risks, and next steps. This saves project managers and teams time when drafting stakeholder updates.

rm-567886.description: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. You can easily customize the report to your needs by specifying the audience, tone, length, and sections you want.
rm-567886.title: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent

ai.action_note: Notify users that they can query Power BI data directly within Microsoft 365 Copilot.
ai.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot can now query and reason over Power BI reports and semantic models. This enables employees to ask natural-language questions and get grounded answers directly from enterprise business data.

rm-567891.description: This release enables M365 Copilot to reason over Power BI enterprise data and returns grounded answers directly from Power BI reports and semantic models. Users can ask natural‑language questions and receive accurate answers.
rm-567891.title: Power BI integration in M365 Copilot

ai.summary: Makers can now share autonomous agents with end users under run-only permissions. This lets employees leverage agent automation without granting them edit rights or ownership, preserving governance.

rm-567894.description: Previously, autonomous agents could only be used and managed by makers, limiting their reach to the people who needed them. Run-only sharing enables makers to securely share autonomous agents with end users, allowing users to benefit from agent-driven automation without requiring edit permissions or ownership. This extends autonomous agent capabilities to a broader audience while maintaining governance and control.
rm-567894.title: Share Autonomous Agents to End Users (Run-Only)

ai.summary: Android users can transcribe audio, capture photos, and type notes in a single Copilot session to generate structured Copilot Pages saved to Notebooks. This helps mobile workers easily document in-person discussions and whiteboard sessions.

rm-567895.description: Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. Designed for capturing offline work moments—including in-person conversations, whiteboard sessions, and personal notes. This capability is already generally available on OneNote for iPhone and iPad.
rm-567895.title: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)

ai.summary: A new Agent Readiness indicator in Copilot Studio alerts makers to blocking issues, policy restrictions, and risks before publishing. This prevents wasted time by graying out unsupported capabilities up front with clear explanations.

rm-568762.description: Agent Readiness gives makers a real-time, always-visible health check for their Copilot Studio agents. A single "Review" indicator in the build experience surfaces anything blocking or at risk — from policy restrictions to missing evaluations — before it derails a publish. Blocked capabilities are grayed out up front with a clear reason, so makers never waste time configuring something that was never going to work.
rm-568762.title: Agent Readiness in Microsoft Copilot Studio

ai.action_note: Review and configure tenant-level rollout and visibility settings for self-serve sync connectors.
ai.summary: Users can now connect external tools like Jira and Confluence directly to Microsoft 365 Copilot using their own credentials. This lets them search and reference project content in Copilot Chat and Microsoft Search, while admins manage rollout and access controls.

rm-568788.description: Self-serve sync connectors enable users to securely connect their own external data sources, such as Jira and Confluence Cloud, to Microsoft 365 Copilot. Using their own credentials and permissions, users can synchronize content they already have access to, making it discoverable in Copilot Chat and Microsoft Search. Administrators maintain oversight through tenant-level controls, including staged rollout, visibility management, and connector disablement.
rm-568788.title: Self-serve sync connectors

ai.summary: Plans to enable Copilot review of PDFs in OneDrive for iOS have been cancelled. The mobile in-context Copilot capability will not move forward at this time.

rm-568790.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot makes PDF reviews faster and easier on mobile. Select text in any PDF in OneDrive iOS and tap Ask Copilot to explain, summarize, translate, or ask a custom question about the selection — the same in-context Copilot experience already generally available on desktop, now on OneDrive iOS. Updated October 20, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.
rm-568790.title: Review PDFs using the Copilot context menu on OneDrive iOS

ai.summary: Copilot Studio now supports Microsoft Dataverse as a native knowledge source. Makers can ground AI agents directly in structured enterprise data, customer records, and business application content.

rm-568929.description: We are enabling Microsoft Dataverse as a native knowledge source in Copilot Studio, expanding the platform’s ability to ground AI agents in structured enterprise data. This enhancement allows organizations to leverage business-critical information stored in Dataverse—including records, customer data, operational data, and business application content—as a trusted knowledge source for agent experiences.
rm-568929.title: Dataverse integration on Copilot Studio

ai.summary: Copilot Studio now supports Azure SQL as a knowledge source. Makers can connect and ground enterprise AI agents in structured data stored across Azure SQL databases.

rm-568930.description: The Azure SQL Knowledge Source capability extends the range of enterprise data sources that makers can leverage when building agents in Copilot Studio. This enables organizations to bring business-critical information stored in Azure SQL into their agent experiences using the same knowledge-centric approach that customers already use across other supported knowledge sources. Azure SQL knowledge support represents another step toward a unified knowledge platform strategy, where customers can connect enterprise data sources through a common knowledge framework and leverage those sources consistently across agent experiences. It also strengthens the story for organizations seeking to build grounded, enterprise-ready AI solutions using existing Microsoft data assets.
rm-568930.title: SQL server Support in Microsoft Copilot Studio

ai.action_note: Train queue agents on using Copilot Chat within the call recap tab.
ai.summary: Users can now launch Copilot Chat from the Recap tab of recorded calls in the Queues app. This allows staff to quickly summarize discussions and query specific call details without reading full transcripts or re-listening to recordings.

rm-568933.description: After a recorded call is completed, use Copilot in the Queues app to quickly catch up on key details, uncover insights, and resolve customer issues faster without having to manually search through a transcript or listen back to a recording. Navigate to the unified call history in the Queues app, select the recorded call record, and launch the Copilot Chat sidecar from within the Recap tab. You can then ask Copilot to generate a summary or answer questions about specific details related to the call.
rm-568933.title: Use Copilot Chat after a call in Queues app

ai.action_note: Inform queue agents about the new Recap tab available for recorded calls.
ai.summary: Recorded calls in the Queues app now include intelligent recaps featuring AI summaries, key discussion points, and follow-up actions. This enables staff to review customer calls faster without listening to full recordings.

rm-569017.description: Spend less time catching up on call recordings to resolve customer issues faster. For recorded call queue calls, the Queues app now supports intelligent call recaps for recorded calls that includes AI-generated summary notes, key discussion points, and follow-up actions. Navigate to the call record in the Queues app and select the Recap tab to access.
rm-569017.title: Intelligent call recaps in Queues app

ai.summary: Users can upload custom skill markdown (.md) files into Brand Kit to use them directly within PowerPoint Copilot. This makes it easier to apply specific instructions and organizational skills to presentation workflows.

rm-569208.description: Create HTML with Copilot in SharePoint or upload your own HTML from another source. rm-569208.title: HTML pages

rm-569210.title: CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks

rm-569211.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports JPG and PNG files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring images directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. Copilot can use the content within these images, including text, charts, diagrams, and other visuals, as grounding context to help generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.
rm-569211.title: JPG and PNG references in Copilot Notebooks

rm-569212.description: Federated Copilot connectors enable users to securely connect Microsoft Copilot to their favorite third party sources, retrieving data in real-time using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). rm-569212.title: Federated Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot

ai.action_note: Advise users on how to access agents and skills using the plus menu and prompt shortcuts.

rm-569214.title: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD

ai.action_note: Inform users about the new OneDrive chat capabilities for analyzing files and generating outputs.

rm-569215.description: With improved Copilot file skills in OneDrive, you can go from files to finished work directly from chat. rm-569215.title: Improved capabilities for files with Copilot in OneDrive Web

Admins can continue to monitor and provide oversight through the current experience in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

rm-569428.description: M365 Copilot now supports Writing blocks. Edit drafts, memos, emails, and more inline while using Chat for easy editing and iteration.
rm-569428.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) Writing Blocks in M365 Copilot

ai.summary: Copilot Chat now displays code, diagrams, and charts inline instead of in a side-by-side canvas. This allows users to preview and review technical outputs directly within their conversation stream.

rm-569429.description: M365 Copilot now supports code blocks, which lets you preview code, charts, diagrams, and more directly inline while using Chat. Previously, users could preview code side-by-side in a code canvas.
rm-569429.title: Code Blocks in M365 Copilot

ai.action_note: Familiarize makers with the new app-first agent creation interface in Copilot Studio.
ai.summary: Copilot Studio is shifting to an app-first creation workflow where creators choose the target application before configuring capabilities. This unifies tools and knowledge into a simplified agent building setup.

rm-569474.description: Copilot Studio is evolving to an app-first agent creation experience. Makers start with the application their agent will work with and configure the capabilities it needs. This update brings tools and knowledge into a more unified experience, simplifying how agents are created and configured.
rm-569474.title: Introducing an App- and Intent-First Agent Creation Experience

ai.action_note: Familiarize makers with the new Agent Viewer and Editor role permissions.
ai.summary: Makers can now share Copilot Studio agents with colleagues using Viewer or Editor permissions with automated security roles. This enables collaborative building, editing, and analytics review in the Copilot harness.

rm-569475.description: Enables sharing of agents with other makers in the new Microsoft Copilot harness. Makers can grant other makers Agent Viewer (view analytics/evaluations only) or Editor (view, edit, configure, share, publish) access to an agent, with auto-assigned security roles.
rm-569475.title: Agent Sharing amongst makers

ai.action_note: Guide agent makers to use the enhanced evaluation traces and dataset generation tools for testing.
ai.summary: Copilot Studio is introducing advanced agent evaluation capabilities, including reasoning traces, run comparisons, knowledge source citations, and automated test dataset generation. These tools help creators debug agent behavior faster and ensure higher-quality responses before deployment.

rm-569607.description: Microsoft Copilot Studio is enhancing the Evaluations experience to help makers better understand agent quality and behavior. New capabilities include richer evaluation explanations, agent reasoning traces, cited knowledge sources, evaluation run comparison, support for larger datasets, customizable test generation, and dataset generation from knowledge sources. These improvements help makers identify quality issues more quickly, understand why evaluations succeed or fail, compare results across runs, and create higher quality evaluation datasets with less manual effort. Additional validation and guidance will help makers resolve configuration issues before running evaluations.
rm-569607.title: Improvements to agent evaluations experience

ai.action_note: Inform analysts and notebook users that Power BI reports can be referenced in prompts.
ai.summary: Users can now reference Power BI reports directly in Copilot Notebooks alongside files. This allows Copilot to ground summaries, briefs, and presentations directly in live organization report data.

rm-569928.description: Copilot Notebooks now lets users add Power BI reports as references, bringing report data directly into their notebooks alongside files. Copilot uses this information to help generate more relevant summaries, presentations, and briefs grounded in the organization's data.
rm-569928.title: Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks

ai.summary: Makers can configure required connectors directly within chat via simple sign-in prompts rather than navigating full settings menus. This streamlines the agent building and setup process.

rm-569930.description: Configure the connectors your agent needs, with a simple in-chat sign-in instead of a full settings experience.
rm-569930.title: Conversational configuration of connectors in Copilot Studio

ai.summary: Enhanced Site Skills management allows users to edit, version, restore, publish, and duplicate Copilot skills across SharePoint sites. This makes it easier to standardize and reuse AI capabilities across the organization.

rm-570155.description: The feature introduces enhanced Site Skills management capabilities, including skill editing, version control, publishing, restoration, and cross-site duplication, enabling organizations to govern and reuse skills more effectively across SharePoint sites.
rm-570155.title: Site Skills in Copilot in SharePoint

ai.action_note: Notify Word users in GCC environments about the new Copilot editing features.
ai.summary: Office 365 GCC users can now access Copilot edit mode directly in Microsoft Word. This allows government workers to co-create, refine, and transform documents with AI assistance.

rm-570277.description: Edit with Copilot in Word is now available to users in Office 365 GCC, enabling government customers to work with Copilot as a co-creator directly in your document to create, refine, and transform documents more efficiently.
rm-570277.title: Copilot edit mode is available to users in Office 365 GCC

ai.action_note: Inform users how to attach meeting files to ground meeting AI and auto-share documents.
ai.summary: Users can add files and links directly to meetings to automatically share them with attendees. Meeting AI, such as the Facilitator agent, uses these attached files to answer questions and improve responses.

rm-570427.description: The new Meeting Shared Files feature allows users to add relevant files and links to their meeting for easy access and to automatically share that content with all meeting participants. AI in the meeting, like the Facilitator agent, uses these files for targeted grounding to answer questions and enhance skill functionality.
rm-570427.title: Meeting Shared Files

ai.action_note: Review and configure governance policies for persistent agent accounts.
ai.summary: Copilot Studio agents can now receive persistent Microsoft 365 accounts with their own mailbox, Teams presence, and Office access. This enables bots to collaborate as standalone entities while admins maintain standard governance and security policies.

rm-570430.description: Makers can now give their Copilot Studio agents their own accounts, making it a governed Microsoft 365 identity for shared, collaborative business processes that spans across teams. With its own mailbox, Teams presence & Office access, the agent can collaborate where work happens while admins can control and govern its access, policies and use as its own first-class entity.
rm-570430.title: Persistent identity for Copilot Studio Agents

ai.summary: Copilot Studio agents will analyze completed runs to suggest converting repeated tool sequences into workflows. This provides makers with actionable recommendations to standardize behavior, reduce errors, and control operational costs.

rm-570432.description: Soon agents can help makers improve agents using lessons from completed runs. It will identify repeated tool sequences that can be handled by workflows to standardize agent behavior, minimize errors, and most importantly control costs. Makers will be presented with recommendations and supporting evidence, expected impact, and the related instruction and tool changes. Makers accept recommendations, configure, test, and publish a refined copy of the agent. This helps improve agent output quality and controls costs while preserving work that requires model judgment and keeping makers in control.
rm-570432.title: Self-learning for Copilot Studio Agents

ai.summary: Copilot Studio agents can now display interactive UI elements like sortable tables directly in chat using Model Context Protocol tools. This lets employees explore and interact with data without switching between different applications.

rm-570433.description: Copilot Studio agents can now render rich, interactive UI inline using MCP Apps, an extension of the Model Context Protocol. When an agent calls a UI-enabled tool from a compatible MCP server, interactive experiences like sortable tables and drilldowns render directly in the conversation. Users can now explore and act on data without leaving the chat or switching tools. A plain-text fallback keeps the agent working on surfaces that can't render the UI, and makers get this simply by connecting a compliant MCP server.
rm-570433.title: Deliver rich interactive app experiences in Copilot Studio agents

ai.summary: Makers can now require human approval before Copilot Studio agents execute specific tools. This adds a safety check right in chat channels so users must review and confirm sensitive actions before they run.

rm-570434.description: Copilot Studio now let’s makers require human approval before an agent runs specific tools. With a per-tool, per-agent toggle, any gated tool call pauses and shows an approval request describing what the agent intends to do, so a person can approve, approve for the session, or deny before the action runs. This gives organizations a deterministic guardrail for high-stakes or sensitive operations like sending emails, closing tickets, or processing payments, independent of the agent's instructions. Approval requests appear inline in the channel where the agent is deployed, including Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot.
rm-570434.title: Enabling makers to require human approval for tool calls

ai.summary: Copilot Studio agent interactions inside Microsoft 365 Copilot will now match standard Copilot Chat formatting and behavior. Users will experience smoother streaming, voice dictation, clickable citations, and visible tool execution traces.

rm-570435.description: This update is meant to bridge the experience of using Copilot Studio agents in M365 Copilot with the Copilot Chat experience. With these updates, agent responses in Copilot Chat will look (similar formatting, compressed chain of thought), feel (smoother streaming, resume/retry and voice dictation) and behave (deliver clickable citations and tool execution traces) very similarly to Copilot Chat responses themselves.
rm-570435.title: Streamlining experiences from Copilot Studio Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot

ai.summary: Copilot Chat can match search results from text embedded in images inside Word and PowerPoint files. This allows users to easily find information previously trapped in scanned contracts, tables, and images.

rm-570469.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, text from tables, text from images — content that was previously difficult to search and find.
rm-570469.title: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files

rm-570854.title: ExpandedContextIQ

rm-570868.description: Enable agents to use supported REST endpoints as tools through governed Work IQ integrations.
rm-570868.title: REST endpoint tools

rm-570870.description: Provide a unified intelligence layer that helps agents discover, reason over, and use organizational knowledge.

rm-570963.description: Copilot brings agentic video creation to Clipchamp Video Hub. Users can generate, edit, and refine videos from prompts—grounded in explicit documents or implicit WorkIQ knowledge. Preview and playback video directly in chat, then continue iterating towards a finished video.
rm-570963.title: Copilot video creation updates

ai.action_note: Review third-party connector write and delete tools in the Microsoft 365 admin center and disable any that violate policy.

ai.summary: Copilot Notebook audio overviews add topic-based episodes, new formats like Critique and Debate, and support for sensitivity labels. These improvements make reviewing long content easier while respecting enterprise information protection rules.

ai.action_note: Enable Dataverse capabilities and author Business Skills to guide Sales Agent responses.
ai.summary: Sales Agent can now follow custom Dataverse Business Skills defined through natural language instructions. This ensures agent responses automatically follow company-specific sales methodologies, processes, and guidance.

rm-571394.description:
Business Skills are natural language instructions authored and stored in Microsoft Dataverse that teach Sales Agent how work gets done within a specific organization. Business Skills enable organizations to create natural language instructions for Sales Agent to follow, which represent their business processes, policies, and business knowledge. Business skills can represent common sales workflows such as lead qualification, pipeline reviews, account planning, opportunity scoring, account brief creation, or organization-specific sales methodologies. Sales Agent uses the instructions in Business Skills to deliver responses that align with the customer's business processes and guidance.

Sellers can interact with Sales agent using natural language and receive responses that are guided by their organization's Business Skills, following admin defined sales processes, applying company specific guidance, and surface insights that reflect how the organization operations.

Administrators enable the required Dataverse capabilities, create and manage Business skills within Dataverse, and control Business skill access. Business skills can be authored using natural language instructions and associated with the organization's CRM environment.
rm-571394.title: Use Dataverse Business Skills in Sales Agent

ai.action_note: Allocate model credits to eligible users and establish a process to manage incoming credit requests.
ai.summary: Chat users can now select usage-based billing models directly from the model selector. Administrators must provision credits for users to access these models and can receive user requests for additional credits.

rm-571400.description: Users will be able to access models that require usage-based billing (UBB) from the model selector in Chat. Tenant admins will need to allocate credits so that users can interact with these models. If users consume their allotted credits, they will be able to request credits from their tenant admins.

The shared catalog powered by Microsoft 365 App Store enables shared skills to extend across experiences such as Copilot Studio M365 copilot, and Cowork, helping organizations standardize proven ways of working while maintaining centralized governance.
rm-571880.title: Discover & Add Skills from the skill catalog

ai.summary: Legal plugins in Word and Cowork allow legal professionals to summarize, draft, review, and redline contracts and documents. The feature integrates work context from Microsoft 365 and supported third-party legal data sources.

rm-571884.description: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.
rm-571884.title: Legal plugins in Copilot

ai.summary: Local inferencing allows AI prompt processing for supported Copilot interactions to take place within specified local geographic boundaries. This helps organizations meet sovereignty and regional data handling requirements.

rm-571886.description:
Local inferencing expands Microsoft Copilot’s sovereign controls by enabling AI inferencing for supported Copilot interactions to occur within the applicable local geography.

Launching in Australia, India, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, and the United States, this capability gives organizations greater control over where AI inferencing occurs, helping them address sovereignty and regional requirements. Inferencing is the processing step when an AI model executes a prompt to produce an output or response.
rm-571886.title: Local inferencing

ai.action_note: Notify users that they can now schedule meetings and book rooms directly within Copilot chat.
ai.summary: Users can now schedule meetings directly from Copilot chat. Copilot finds open times, books rooms, drafts agendas, and sends calendar invites without requiring users to switch to their calendar app.

rm-573220.description: Users can now schedule appointments and meetings directly from chat. Simply ask Copilot to create an appointment or schedule a meeting with colleagues, and it will find available times, book rooms, draft agendas, and send invites—all within the chat experience.
rm-573220.title: Scheduling with Copilot

ai.action_note: Configure and turn on the semantic model and data signals in the Power Apps Maker Portal.
ai.summary: Administrators can enable and configure a semantic model for the Sales agent across Dynamics 365 and Salesforce data. This helps the agent better understand CRM metadata and answer complex queries across related records.

rm-573294.description:
Semantic model helps Sales Agent understand the structure and meaning of an organization’s CRM data. It creates a connected representation of CRM metadata, including tables or objects, fields, descriptions, data types, relationships, views, pick-list values, and glossary terms. Sales Agent can retrieve this context when responding to questions, improving its ability to interpret business language and answer complex questions that span related CRM records.

Dynamics 365 admins can enable and turn on semantic model in Power Apps Maker Portal and configure the data coverage and signals that Sales Agent should use. Admins can configure the underlying data, views, metadata and relationships used in the model.

For Salesforce customers, the semantic model will be based on existing Sales agent table and glossary configuration in Sales agent settings or Power Apps Maker Portal. In Power Apps Maker Portal, Salesforce admins will can configure additional Salesforce signals to use in semantic model such as relationships and views.
rm-573294.title: Enable semantic model in Sales agent

rm-573446.description: Copilot in OneNote can generate new content and directly edit when in edit mode. ai.action_note: Brief sales representatives on how the agent coordinates calendar bookings and handoffs.
ai.summary: Sales Development Agent can now automatically coordinate and book meetings with prospects using sellers' calendars. This saves sellers time by handling scheduling and passing conversation context directly to the team.

rm-575289.description: Sales Development Agent can turn a prospect’s interest in meeting into a booked seller meeting. The agent asks the prospect to provide preferred dates and times, evaluates those options against the appropriate seller’s calendar, and books the first valid option in the prospect’s stated preference order. The seller and prospect receive the meeting invitation, while the seller receives additional conversation context to support a warm handoff. If scheduling cannot be completed, the agent transfers the request and relevant context to the seller for follow-up.
rm-575289.title: Sales Development Agent - Meeting scheduling

ai.action_note: Review and configure spending policies for Copilot Studio environments and agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
ai.summary: Administrators can manage Copilot Studio credit spending and enforce spending policies directly within the Microsoft 365 admin center. This centralizes cost governance across usage-based AI workloads, environments, and agents.

apps: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration
rm-577834.description:
We’re expanding cost management for Microsoft Copilot Studio into the Microsoft 365 admin center. This gives administrators a more centralized way to manage Copilot Credit spend across usage-based AI workloads while retaining Copilot Studio cost management capabilities in the Power Platform admin center.

With this update, administrators can bring supported Copilot Studio environments and agents under Cost Management spending policies. Resource-based policies for environments and agents are the first planned scopes, with broader user and group policy support planned for a later phase.

Furthermore, this update will introduce cost data into cost management and agent registry for AI services and agents built on Microsoft platforms (e.g., Cowork, Microsoft Copilot Studio agents).
roadmap_tags: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration
rm-577834.title: Copilot studio cost controls in MAC

rm-577841.title: Copilot app mode handoffs
